events.title: SOLAR PARTICLE EVENT
events.description: X-class flare detected. Energetic particles will reach the spacecraft in approximately 40 minutes.

choices.outcome: Electronics rode it out. Data collection paused for six hours.

choices.text: Ride it out with full systems

events.title: MICROMETEOROID IMPACT
events.description: Hull sensor registered a strike on the outer skin. Pressure is holding. Damage assessment required.

choices.outcome: Impact confirmed superficial. No structural loss.

events.title: COMMS ARRAY DRIFT
events.description: The high-gain antenna has lost lock with the Deep Space Network. Signal strength dropping.

choices.outcome: Slow but functional. Data backlog accumulating.

events.title: NAVIGATION DRIFT
events.description: Star tracker has picked up a small course error. Left uncorrected it will grow.

events.title: BATTERY CELL FAULT
events.description: One battery string is discharging faster than expected. Thermal warning triggered.

choices.outcome: Lose capacity but save the rest of the bank.

events.title: TARGET OF OPPORTUNITY
events.description: A near-Earth object is passing close to the trajectory. Good scientific return if you divert.

choices.outcome: Close pass imaged. Sample data is excellent.

events.title: CREW FATIGUE
events.description: Six months of transit is taking a toll. Task completion has dropped below nominal.

choices.outcome: Crew recovers. Science paused for two weeks.

events.title: THERMAL ANOMALY
events.description: Spacecraft thermal balance is drifting. One side is running hotter than planned.

choices.outcome: Temperatures evened out. Science briefly paused.

events.title: UNEXPECTED SIGNAL
events.description: The antenna picked up a narrow-band transmission from an unknown source. Not DSN. Not a known satellite.

choices.outcome: Signal recorded. Analysis will happen on the ground.

events.title: ATTITUDE ERROR
events.description: Reaction wheels are fighting an unexpected torque. The spacecraft is slowly rotating.

choices.outcome: Wheels reset. Slight attitude drift remains.
